messages.subject: Renewable Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Carina,

Whitham Group's executive-search work across renewable energy makes this a focused introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across ESG/social performance, government and regulatory relations, external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder coordination.

I am internationally mobile and open to Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where renewable growth, stakeholder strategy and responsible development converge.

My executive CV is attached for consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
